one_line: Sisodia ruler of Mewar who restored Chittor in the 14th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, athletic and wiry with a swordsman’s build, neither bulky nor thin.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium wheatish complexion tanned from sun, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed moustache that curves slightly upward at the ends, short close beard along the jaw, intense almond eyes with a calm but resolute default expression.
appearance.hair: Long black hair gathered at the back and hidden under a wrapped Rajput-style turban in deep saffron-orange with a narrow dark green band and a small central golden kalgi plume, no loose hair visible under the turban.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 14th-century Rajput warrior attire: a fitted quilted cotton angarkha in muted off-white with fine vertical stitching, reaching mid-thigh and belted; over it a sleeveless steel-coloured mail-and-plate vest with small rectangular plates riveted over mail; a dark red cloth kamarband sash wrapped at the waist with one end tucked and hanging slightly to the left; loose churidar-style trousers in pale beige tucked into sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf; a light ochre cotton patka/scarf draped from left shoulder across the chest and back, edges decorated with simple dark green borders; simple yet elegant jewellery limited to a thin gold neck torque, a small circular gold earring in each ear, and a plain iron bangle on the right wrist, emphasizing noble but battle-ready simplicity.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, brass hilt, and disc pommel, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings and worn at his left hip through the red kamarband, usually drawn and held in his right hand in dynamic scenes.

ref_desc: Maharana Hammir Singh is a mid-30s Rajput warrior with wheatish complexion, curved moustache, black hair under a saffron turban, wearing an off-white quilted angarkha, steel-grey mail vest, beige churidar, dark red sash, brown boots, and carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Maharana Hammir Singh as a dignified 14th-century Rajput ruler: a mid-30s, athletic man with an oval face, wheatish sun-tanned skin, sharp cheekbones, a straight nose, intense almond eyes, a neatly trimmed moustache that curves slightly upward, and a short close beard along the jaw, his long black hair fully concealed under a wrapped Rajput turban in deep saffron-orange with a narrow dark green band and a small central golden plume. Dress him in an off-white, fitted quilted cotton angarkha with visible vertical stitching reaching mid-thigh, belted at the waist, over which he wears a sleeveless steel-grey mail-and-plate vest with small rectangular plates; tie a dark red cloth kamarband tightly around his waist, with one end hanging slightly to the left, and add loose pale beige churidar trousers tucked into sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf. Drape a light ochre cotton patka from his left shoulder across chest and back with simple dark green edging, and give him minimal jewellery: a thin gold neck torque, small circular gold earrings, and a plain iron bangle on his right wrist. At his left hip, show a slightly curved Rajput talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, the hilt in brass with a disc pommel; in some poses he lightly grips the sheathed sword, in others he holds the drawn talwar in his right hand in a ready but composed stance. Use a palette dominated by saffron orange, dark red, off-white, steel grey, dark green, and brown leather, and present front, side, and back views to clearly show consistent hair concealment, turban shape, armour, garments, and sword placement in a heroic yet historically grounded style.
